name: 亚历克斯·伊斯特
name_full: 亚历克斯·伊斯特 Alex East
introduction: Alex East is an actor based in Prague, Czech Republic. He performs in Russian, Czech, and English. Passionate about acting, he has been training in both English and Czech programs, developing his skills for international work. Open to new opportunities in film, television, and stage, he continues to grow his craft and explore diverse roles.
